explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1099 with Vose's positive answer: for every α > 1 there is C with h_α(n) ≤ C for infinitely many n, which is the stated reading of 'liminf h_α(n) ≪_α 1'. h_α is computed from the increasing enumeration Nat.nth (· ∣ n). For n ≥ 1 this enumerates exactly the divisors, because 0 ∤ n, and the sum runs over the τ(n) - 1 consecutive ratios, so the definition is right.
